integrity: Unconditional elementary proof; a portable exact finite verifier is included as corroboration, not an infinite proof; originality assessed from the checked literature with residual unindexed-work risk.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to 2^a p^b with odd prime p, a>=1, b>=2; no claim of infinitely many Fermat primes or all integer solutions. A 2005 journal issue is earlier than the earliest verified exact-day bibliographic entry (2006-01-10), but its initial online posting day is unresolved.
title: Fermat-prime rigidity for Euler–Carmichael composition coincidences on \(2^a p^b\)
